notes.title: [2025-07-17] Gameplay Update - Mark a Spot on the Table
notes.notes:
Update content
Just now, we made some updates to the game.
The content of this gameplay update is:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/7a6f4c608bc7057b7ea6b09c08013d7fe89616b6.gif
 Added a new function which allows players to mark spots on the table surface when they are not hitting the ball or observing the table surface, which can help players communicate more intuitively. (Control mode: left mouse button/controller A button)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png
Some related features
In the shooter's perspective, the mark will be more transparent and the sound effect will be smaller to reduce interference.
The mark lasts for 5 seconds, and a player can have at most one mark at a time.
Only supports marking positions on the table. (Don’t mark the threads on other people’s clothes)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png

notes.title: [2025-06-13]Hotfix - Optimize Network
notes.notes:
Recent Download Issues
Recently, many players have reported that Steam will have some download-related issues such as "Unable to connect to content server" when downloading/updating games. Many other game developers have also encountered similar problems. We initially determined that the problem is that Steam's content server has fluctuated. Generally, restarting Steam or changing the download region can solve the problem.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png
Attached is Valve's official solution to this situation:
https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/21F5-8D5D-0141-7A5E
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png
Update Content

This update includes:

Optimize network logic and fix the bug that caused the ball to have a short delay after being touched and started to move.

Feel free to report bugs to us via wavebox66@gmail.com!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png
The content of this gameplay update is:

The current order is now displayed in the upper left corner of the game. (Thanks to Eno Tanchanco, Guilherme Ferreira for feedback)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png
Some Details about Shooting Order
The shooting order logic in the game is:

At the beginning of a game, a player is randomly selected as the first, and the game is played in a counterclockwise order.
When a new round starts, the last shooter of the previous round shoots first, but the order is reversed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png
